fields.description: Decides the plan.

fields.label: Worker Model
fields.description: Fast model. Runs the tool loop and writes the draft.

fields.label: Reflector Model
fields.description: Strongest model you have. Judges and reflects.

fields.label: Preferred Domains
fields.description: Comma separated, added to the built-in list. Used to score source quality.

fields.label: Max Trials
fields.description: How many times the agent may re-plan and retry after a failed evaluation.

fields.label: Pass Threshold
fields.description: Weighted evaluator score, 0 to 1, needed to stop early.

fields.label: Use LLM Judge
fields.description: Adds one model call per trial for completeness and usefulness scoring.

fields.label: Log Full Prompts
fields.description: Verbose. Turn on only while debugging.

fields.label: Allow Read-Only SQL
fields.description: Lets the agent write SELECT queries for joins. Every table is still doctype-permission-checked, but a hand-written query cannot have a User Permission restriction (Territory, Cost Center) verified against it, so any user with such a restriction is refused this tool outright.

fields.label: DocType Allowlist
fields.description: Leave empty to allow every DocType the user already has read permission on. Add rows to narrow the agent to a specific surface.

fields.label: Allow Write Actions
fields.description: Lets the agent PROPOSE changes. It can never write directly. Every proposal becomes an Agent Action Request that a human approves.

fields.label: Writable DocTypes
fields.description: Leave empty to allow any DocType the user can already write. Recommended: name them explicitly.

fields.label: Write Blocklist
fields.description: Comma separated. Added to the built-in hard blocklist.

fields.label: Enable Auto-Approve
fields.description: Executes low-risk proposals without a human click. Submit, Cancel and Delete are never auto-approved.

fields.label: Allow Self Approval
fields.description: Off means the person who asked cannot approve their own action. Leave off unless you are a single-user site.

fields.label: Auto-Approve Value Ceiling
fields.description: Proposals above this value always need a human. 0 means no ceiling, which is not recommended.

fields.label: Enable Document Search
fields.description: Indexes PDFs and images attached to ERPNext documents so the agent can search their contents. Permissions are inherited from the document each file is attached to.

fields.label: Embedding Model
fields.description: Uses OpenAI. Document text is sent to this API at index time.

fields.label: Index Files Attached To
fields.description: Only files attached to these DocTypes are indexed. Leave empty to index files on any DocType the reader can already access.

fields.label: Never Index
fields.description: Comma separated, added to a built-in payroll blocklist that cannot be switched off. Content here is never retrievable, whatever the permissions say.

fields.label: Index Unattached Files
fields.description: Files with no parent document inherit no permission. Off means they are never searchable. Turn on only if your Drive files are safe for every user.

fields.label: OCR Scanned Pages
fields.description: Pages with no text layer are sent to a vision model as images. Costs a fraction of a cent per page and is the only way scanned invoices work.

fields.label: Use External MCP Servers
fields.description: Lets the agent call tools from servers registered under MCP Server.

fields.label: Expose ERPNext as an MCP Server
fields.description: Serves this app's ERPNext tools at /api/method/research_agent.agent.mcp.server.handle so Claude Desktop and other MCP clients can query the ERP. Authenticate with a Frappe API key.
